reference: R limma 3.66.0: lmFit for coefficients, sigma, df.residual and Amean; limma::fitFDist's algebra transcribed with the covariate design cbind(splines::ns(Amean, df, intercept = TRUE), splines::ns(log(n_peptides), df = 2) or log(n_peptides)), fitted by stats::lm.fit, df.prior by limma::trigammaInverse; posterior as limma's .squeezeVar; p on eBayes's capped df.total. Without the count block the transcription reproduces limma::eBayes(trend = TRUE) to 1e-12 on every case, which the generator checks before writing.
note: Each case's design is the one the toolkit builds for its analysis_type from the sample labels beside it, and the second coefficient is tested. spline_df is limma's rule for the Amean spline; count_cols is 2 for a natural spline of log count with one interior knot at the median, 1 when the counts take only two values or the median count is the smallest or largest, where R's ns() refuses and both tools use log count itself. df_prior_limma_trend is limma-trend's prior df on the same case, for comparison.
